services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Tellus education department understands the needs of teachers - public, private or home school - scout leaders and other educators. Bring your students to Tellus Science Museum for Field Trips. Our 2-hour programs include a museum gallery tour and hands-on lab experience. Virtual Field Trips provides an engaging downloadable curriculum packet, a video segment and up to 60 minutes of virtual learning with a Tellus Science Museum Educator. All programs meet the Georgia Standards of Excellence. Click below to request a guided field trip program. For self-guided group programs, please submit a request here.
